items.title: Merck (MRK) Posts An Overall Survival Win, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) is back in focus after its TroFuse-015 Phase 3 trial reported an overall survival benefit for sacituzumab tirumotecan in heavily pretreated gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, while missing the study’s progression-free survival goal.
